verdict.rationale: Codegen offers a Python SDK and REST API to programmatically launch agents, retrieve traces, and explicitly supports triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines on build failures, plus a CLI for headless invocation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of real CI pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions example), and a public OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s), which limits confidence in robustness for automation at scale.
